_source: Building positions derived from the labeled campus map image on page 1 of the EHS Tour Guide Handout (Google Doc 18WxqlSPnm5huygPSpcWVmn_iJ81UwZQq9vnh3PJxgOQ), cross-checked for cardinal orientation against a Google Maps satellite view of 3600 Central Parkway, Dublin, CA (compass needle confirmed north-up). Both sources agree: Central Parkway runs along the north edge, Grafton Street along the east, with Finninan Way wrapping the south side.

campus_context.orientation: North is up on both the EHS Tour Guide Handout campus map and the Google Maps satellite view (verified by the on-map compass needle).

boundary_streets.north: Central Parkway — Parking Lot A runs the length of the campus along this edge, with the main driveway entrance from Central Pkwy.
boundary_streets.south: Finninan Way wraps the south side of campus; the Athletic Field (Stadium) sits inside the campus just north of it.
boundary_streets.west: Devaney Park forms the west edge of campus; Chancery Lane runs north-south further west (visible on Google Maps).

zones.north: Parking Lot A along Central Parkway.
zones.upper_middle: The main building complex: Student Union / Theater / VAPA cluster on the west (blue buildings on the handout map), and Administration / Library on the east (yellow buildings).
zones.center_east: Gymnasium (Building M) and Locker Rooms (Building L) — an orange cluster on the east side.
zones.southwest: Academic Tower 1 (Building F / ACADEMY 1) and south of it Academic Tower 2 (Building G / ACADEMY 2), both yellow on the handout map.
zones.south: Stadium (athletic field + 8-lane track) in the south-center, Tennis Courts in the SW corner, Devaney Park along the west.

A.name: Administration (Building A)
A.position: East side of the main building complex, in the upper (north) portion. On the handout map, Admin is a yellow building directly south of the Food Court area and north of the Library (Building E). Reach it via the main driveway from Central Parkway through Parking Lot A, or from Grafton Street on the east.
A.notes: Two floors. Floor 1 houses the Administration Offices, Health Center, and Staff Lounge. Floor 2 has the Wellness Center, Counselor Offices, and Student Services Offices.

C.name: Visual & Performing Arts (Building C)
C.position: West-center of the main building complex. On the handout map, VAPA is a blue building directly south of the Theater (part of the VAPA Phase 2 expansion) and south-west of the Student Union; north of Academic Tower 1 (Building F / ACADEMY 1).
C.notes: Band, Choir, and Theatre Arts classrooms; Ceramics & Sculpture and Visual Arts studios. A Phase 2 expansion (completed July 2025) added a Dance Studio, Video Production Studio, and Theater Make-up & Locker Room — the Theater is labeled separately on the handout map, immediately north of the VAPA building.

D.name: Student Union (Building D)
D.position: North-west portion of the main building complex. On the handout map, Student Union is the large blue building at the top of the west cluster, directly south of Parking Lot A / Central Parkway.
D.notes: Climate-controlled indoor–outdoor flexible gathering space. Houses the ASB Activities Center, Food Court, and a 150-seat Lecture Hall. The Catherine C. Kuo Performing Arts Center is planned as part of the Phase 3 expansion here. (The handout map labels the Food Court separately on the east side of the building — treat it as the Food Court space within the Student Union footprint.)

E.name: Library / ACCESS Center (Building E)
E.position: East-center of the main building complex. On the handout map, the Library is a yellow building directly south of Administration (Building A) and north of the Gymnasium (Building M).
E.notes: Two floors. Floor 1: Library and Media & Technology Center. Floor 2: Academic College & Career Education Student Support (ACCESS) Center.

F.name: Academic Tower 1 (Building F)
F.position: South-west portion of campus. On the handout map, Academic Tower 1 is labeled ACADEMY 1 — a yellow building south of VAPA (Building C) and north of Academic Tower 2 (Building G / ACADEMY 2). Parking Lot B sits adjacent to it in the center of campus.
F.notes: Three floors; 36 academic classrooms including 2 computer labs, 4 chemistry labs, and 6 science flex labs, all accessible via 4 staircases and an elevator. Also houses the Special Education Offices and 2 Special Education Lifeskills rooms. The main vestibule has showcase cabinets and provides north–south access from the Main Courtyard to Academic Tower 2 (Building G). Restrooms on every floor; a 2nd-floor Walking Bridge to Academic Tower 2 is part of Phase 2.

G.name: Academic Tower 2 (Building G)
G.position: South-west portion of campus, directly south of Academic Tower 1 (Building F / ACADEMY 1). On the handout map it is labeled ACADEMY 2. Linked to Academic Tower 1 by the 2nd-floor Walking Bridge.
G.notes: Second academic tower, completed July 2025. Linked to Academic Tower 1 (Building F) by the 2nd-floor Walking Bridge.

L.name: Locker Rooms (Building L)
L.position: Far east side of campus, directly adjacent to the Gymnasium (Building M) on its east side — a small orange building on the handout map. Along Grafton Street.
L.notes: Girls and Boys locker rooms, Kinesiology Lab, and Weight Room.

M.name: Gymnasium (Building M)
M.position: East-center of the main building complex — the large orange building on the handout map. Directly south of the Library (Building E), north-east of Academic Tower 1 (Building F), and immediately west of the Locker Rooms (Building L). North of the Stadium.
M.notes: 2,400-seat bleacher gym with 3 basketball courts and 9 volleyball/badminton courts. Also contains the PE Fitness Classroom.

Administration Office.position: East side of main building complex (upper portion), inside Building A — south of the Food Court area and north of the Library.
Administration Office.description: Main administration office — first stop for visitors, phones, and front-desk questions.

Health Center.description: On-campus Health Center for medical issues during the school day.

Staff Lounge.description: Staff lounge, Building A floor 1 (staff only).

Wellness Center.description: Mental-health and wellness support space, 2nd floor of Building A alongside the counselor offices.

Counselor Offices.description: Academic / college counselors' offices on the 2nd floor of Building A. For which counselor a specific student is assigned to, use lookup_counselor_by_last_name.

Student Services.description: Student Services offices (registrar, records, etc.), 2nd floor of Building A.

Library.position: East-center of main complex, inside Building E — directly south of Administration (Building A) and north of the Gymnasium (Building M).
Library.description: School library and Media & Technology Center, 1st floor of Building E.

Media & Technology Center.description: Shares the 1st floor of Building E with the Library.

ACCESS Center.description: Academic College & Career Education Student Support (ACCESS) Center — academic help and college-prep resources, 2nd floor of Building E.

Food Court.position: Inside the Student Union (Building D), in the north-west portion of the main complex. The handout map labels 'FOOD COURT' pointing to the east side of the Student Union footprint.
Food Court.description: Student dining area inside the Student Union (Building D).

ASB Activities Center.description: Associated Student Body activity office / events space inside the Student Union (north-west of main complex).

Lecture Hall.description: 150-seat lecture hall inside the Student Union (north-west of main complex).

Band Room.description: Band classroom in the Visual & Performing Arts building (Building C), west-center of main complex.

Choir Room.description: Choir classroom in the Visual & Performing Arts building (Building C), west-center of main complex.

Theatre Arts Room.position: Inside Building C (VAPA), west-center of main complex. The handout map labels 'THEATER' immediately north of the VAPA building — part of the VAPA Phase 2 expansion.
Theatre Arts Room.description: Theatre Arts classroom in Building C.

Ceramics & Sculpture Studio.description: Ceramics & Sculpture studio in Building C.

Visual Arts Studio.description: Visual Arts studio in Building C.

Dance Studio.description: Dance studio added in the Phase 2 Building C expansion (July 2025).

Video Production Studio.description: Video Production studio added in the Phase 2 Building C expansion (July 2025).

Catherine C. Kuo Performing Arts Center.description: Performing Arts Center planned as part of the Phase 3 expansion inside the Student Union (Building D). Not yet open.

Chemistry Labs.description: Four chemistry labs inside Academic Tower 1 (Building F), south-west portion of campus.

Science Flex Labs.description: Six science flex labs inside Academic Tower 1 (Building F), south-west portion of campus.

Computer Labs.description: Two computer labs inside Academic Tower 1 (Building F), south-west portion of campus.

Special Education Offices.description: Special Education offices and two Special Education Lifeskills rooms inside Academic Tower 1 (Building F).

Walking Bridge.position: South-west portion of campus — the 2nd-floor covered bridge spans from Academic Tower 1 (Building F / ACADEMY 1) south to Academic Tower 2 (Building G / ACADEMY 2).
Walking Bridge.description: A 2nd-floor covered walking bridge connecting Academic Tower 1 (Building F) and Academic Tower 2 (Building G). Part of the Phase 2 construction.

Girls Locker Room.description: Girls locker room in Building L (far east side of campus, adjacent to the Gym).

Boys Locker Room.description: Boys locker room in Building L (far east side of campus, adjacent to the Gym).

Kinesiology Lab.description: Kinesiology lab in Building L (far east side of campus, adjacent to the Gym).

Weight Room.description: Weight Room in Building L (far east side of campus, adjacent to the Gym).

Gym.position: East-center of main complex (Building M) — south of the Library, north of the Stadium, west of the Locker Rooms.
Gym.description: The main gymnasium: 2,400 bleacher seats, 3 basketball courts, 9 volleyball/badminton courts.

PE Fitness Classroom.description: PE Fitness classroom inside the Gymnasium (Building M), east-center of main complex.

Stadium.position: South-center of campus, below the Gymnasium (Building M). The 8-lane track wraps the football field; Finninan Way runs south of it.

Tennis Courts.position: South-west corner of campus, west of the Stadium and south of Devaney Park (green courts on the handout map).
Tennis Courts.description: Eight tennis courts in the SW corner of campus.

Main Courtyard.position: Central area of campus — the plaza that Academic Tower 1 (Building F) opens off of, with north–south access through F's main vestibule to Academic Tower 2 (Building G).
Main Courtyard.description: The central courtyard; Academic Tower 1 (Building F) opens off it, with north–south access through Building F's main vestibule to Academic Tower 2 (Building G).

Snack Bar.description: An exterior Snack Bar with adjacent restrooms.

Devaney Park.position: Along the west edge of campus (labeled DEVANEY PARK on the handout map), between the main building complex and the residential streets further west.
Devaney Park.description: Open green space on the west edge of campus.

Parking Lot A.position: North edge of campus, running the length of the campus along Central Parkway. The main driveway entrance from Central Pkwy opens into this lot.
Parking Lot A.description: Main visitor and staff parking lot along Central Parkway.

Parking Lot B.position: Central area of campus, adjacent to Academic Tower 1 (Building F) — labeled on the handout map between the main building complex and the Academic Towers.
Parking Lot B.description: Secondary parking lot in the center of campus near Academic Tower 1.

navigation_notes: Cardinal orientation (confirmed on both the EHS Tour Guide Handout campus map and Google Maps satellite with its on-map compass): north is up. Central Parkway runs along the north edge, Grafton Street along the east, Finninan Way wraps the south side, and Devaney Park sits along the west.
The main driveway entrance is on the north side off Central Parkway, into Parking Lot A, which runs the length of the north edge of campus.
Visitors should start at the Administration Office (Building A, floor 1). On the handout map Building A sits on the east side of the main complex — south of the Food Court and north of the Library.

The main building complex has two sides: west cluster (blue on the handout map) with Student Union (Building D) at the top, Theater and VAPA (Building C) below; and east cluster (yellow) with Administration (Building A) at the top, Library/ACCESS (Building E) below, and Gymnasium (Building M, orange) south of Library.

Academic Tower 1 (Building F / ACADEMY 1) sits south-west, south of VAPA; Academic Tower 2 (Building G / ACADEMY 2) is directly south of F. The two are joined by a 2nd-floor Walking Bridge, and the main vestibule of F runs north-south between the Main Courtyard and G.

Athletics cluster together: Gymnasium (Building M) east-center with the Locker Rooms (Building L) immediately east of it, and the Stadium (football field + 8-lane track) south of M. Tennis Courts sit in the SW corner.

Food Court is inside the Student Union (Building D) in the north-west, though the handout map labels FOOD COURT separately on the east side of that building footprint — treat them as the same building.

This map data is sourced from the EHS Tour Guide Handout's labeled campus map (page 1 of the handout). If someone asks about a building or room that isn't listed here (for example a specific Building B that the handout doesn't describe), say the handout doesn't cover it and point them at the Administration Office at (925) 551-4040.
